---
title: "Publications"
---

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| results: asis
pubs <- read.csv("data/publications.csv", stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
pubs <- pubs[order(-pubs$year), ]
for (y in unique(pubs$year)) {
  cat("\n## ", y, "\n\n", sep = "")
  sub <- pubs[pubs$year == y, ]
  for (i in seq_len(nrow(sub))) {
    cat("- ", sub$authors[i], ". **", sub$title[i], "**. *",
        sub$journal[i], "* (", sub$year[i], ").\n", sep = "")
  }
}
```
